subject: [PATCH 00/10] mm/madvise: refactor cold and pageout page table walks

reviews.author: Gregory Price
reviews.summary: Identified potential issues in the original implementation and suggested improvements to make the code more readable and maintainable. Proposed a series of patches with refactored code, including separating huge-PMD handling, PTE batching, PTE lock ownership, and other responsibilities.

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch series refactors the cold and pageout page table walks in the Linux kernel's mm/madvise module to improve code readability, maintainability, and performance. The current implementation is a complex nest of functions that handle various scenarios, including huge PMDs, PTE-mapped large folios, ordinary PTEs, folio splitting, and deferred PAGEOUT reclaim. The series separates these responsibilities into distinct functions, making the code easier to understand and audit.
